Call Summary | Housing samples
From: Priya, product engineering

The lab has confirmed that all four housings have arrived. Its technician will photograph the labels before opening the protective bags.

We asked the lab to report the results in the units shown on our request. Its summary template normally uses a different unit. To prevent confusion, the laboratory will show both values and identify which is the converted value.

After testing, the lab sends a draft to the person who requested the work. Engineering reviews technical results, but the lab also sends the billing contact a separate fee summary. The billing contact asked for the draft when it arrives. I’ll ask the lab to send her the fee summary when the draft is ready. She said she needed to estimate this month’s costs, not review the measurements.

The lab plans to finish on Thursday. If it cannot complete all four, report the finished results first and list the others as pending rather than entering a zero.
